invariants.rationale: It is likely that writeStatuses, as a required argument for committing results, is not null when this method is called.
result is meant to carry metadata for the write and should not be null at method entry.
writeStatuses is declared as List<WriteStatus> and should be an instance of List.
result is declared as HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, so should be an instance of HoodieWriteMetadata.
